items.statement: Check full Cy/OEt identities and deethylation bookkeeping, distinguish the B-interacting O atom from other phosphonate oxygens through explicit mapping, and preserve Li/MeCN charge/stoichiometry in whatever models are used. Coordinate and atom labels from different crystal/model files are not automatically equivalent.

items.statement: Any attribution must be supported by evidence capable of separating the claimed effects, with explicitly defined model/environment and uncertainty. An observed crystal dimer does not itself validate a finite optimized dimer or mandate its calculation for a narrower conclusion.

items.statement: Conclusions concern the full experimental identities or explicitly labeled approximations. A methyl-truncated model does not automatically establish the geometry of the full Cy/OEt lithium salt. Finite structures do not prove solution aggregation, reaction kinetics, solubility, electrolyte performance or thermal robustness. A gas-phase model and a crystal are different physical environments.
